propositions: Plan-review Pass 1's current checkpoint identity omits policy, prompt, contract, and topology inputs, causing lost operational context and incorrect reuse eligibility.

A new plan-review strategy adapter must compile the current Round-A discovery topology into DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through the S2 shared kernel while preserving existing YAML/BPMN, facet packing, model ladder, concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation behavior.

Failed local units cannot serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes must survive, independent work must continue, dependents must skip, and the final verdict must follow the approved blocking/advisory-only policy rule.

The checkpoint key must change when material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes, causing legacy and corrupt entries to produce zero reuse.
Only content-identical success/resume envelopes seed checkpoint reuse; failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed units remain missing and must be callable on later runs.
The new reducer-ignored review journal must store the safe versioned trace while review-plan and review-plan --status outputs retain only their established end-result fields.
